data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m (2014: GBP 28.0m) due primarily to a reduction in the assessment of third party liability claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2015 and a release of catastrophe loads on 2014 year of account as policies come off risk (2014: better than anticipated experience in medical malpractice, a deterioration on motor lines of business and a release of catastrophe loads on 2013 year of account).

prior_year_events.impact_description: Expected ultimate gross loss across all years of account is GBP 76.2m, of which GBP 57.5m had been incurred at year end.
Across all years of account the syndicate had gross incurred losses from the international cat events of GBP 21.3m with a further provision of GBP 7.7m.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 were GBP 342.3m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded an overall favourable development (surplus) in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m, driven principally by lower-than-expected development on third party liability (casualty) claims from 2013 and prior years and by releases of catastrophe loadings (notably as 2014 policies came off risk). The closure included ongoing monitoring of long-tail casualty and catastrophe exposures, with RITC activity noted elsewhere in the report.

a reduction in the assessment of third party liability claims on the 2013 and prior accounts following lower than expected incurred claims movements during 2015
a release of catastrophe loads on 2014 year of account as policies come off risk

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development taken from explicit narrative sentence: 'overall surplus in ultimate claims of GBP 27.1m'. A gross claims development triangle is present but includes an aggregated '2010 and prior' column and the syndicate accepted RITC from Syndicate 6103 which can distort triangles; therefore the explicit narrative figure was used as primary. Opening reserves sourced from Statement of Financial Position (gross claims outstanding at 31/12/2014). All monetary amounts reported in millions. Some LOB-level amounts for prior-year development are not quantified in the text and are therefore null.
